purpose: Source-linked analysis recipes that a generic capability may bind to compatible site-pack planes. Inclusion is not permission to run a method when its assumptions or gates fail.

sources.role: GPL-3.0 detection-aware occupancy code and published model summaries
MIT-licensed range, trend, uncertainty and visualisation reference code

method_cards.label: Sampled adult-tree count plus basal area and carbon per hectare
method_cards.allowed_claim: adult-tree count in a sampled plot or area-normalised basal area and carbon in sampled plots
method_cards.forbidden_claim: estate-wide stock without a design-based or model-based expansion
review_notes: The source figure code labels the unscaled adult-tree row count as density. This card retains it as a sampled-plot count; only basal area and carbon are multiplied by 25 in the source code.

method_cards.label: Plot diversity by habitat, origin, conservation and dispersal traits

formulae.species_richness: count(distinct accepted_taxon_name among eligible tree rows)
formulae.old_growth_species_richness: count(distinct accepted_taxon_name where habitat_affinity is mature forest)
formulae.introduced_species_richness: count(distinct accepted_taxon_name where origin is introduced)
formulae.threatened_or_endemic_richness: count(distinct accepted_taxon_name where distribution is endemic or assessment_status is CR, EN or VU)
formulae.medium_large_animal_dispersed_richness: count(distinct accepted_taxon_name where origin is not introduced, disperser_class includes bird or mammal, and seed_size is medium or large)

method_cards.denominator: sampled plot and life-stage protocol; richness is not divided by record count
method_cards.allowed_claim: trait-qualified richness in the sampled adult-tree or regeneration assemblage
method_cards.forbidden_claim: a species interaction, dispersal event, local absence or landscape-wide richness

method_cards.label: Similarity of a sampled community to reference plots
method_cards.denominator: all eligible declared reference plots with compatible sampling protocols
method_cards.allowed_claim: compositional similarity to the declared reference plots under the stated metric
method_cards.forbidden_claim: complete recovery, causal restoration effect or similarity to an unsampled historical condition
gates: reference class is declared before inspecting outcomes
sampling protocols and life stages are compatible
abundance matrix and zero handling are preserved
implementation matches vegan::vegdist(method='chao') on a parity fixture

method_cards.label: Observed response along a canopy-cover gradient

source_instantiation.reference_line: mean response among declared benchmark plots

method_cards.uncertainty: show fitted interval, raw plot points, reference distribution or line, sample size and model diagnostics
method_cards.allowed_claim: modelled association between measured canopy cover and the response within the fitted support
method_cards.forbidden_claim: causal canopy effect, extrapolation beyond supported canopy values, or recovery inferred from a fitted mean alone
gates: retain raw points and treatment labels
report the observed canopy support
check residual fit and influential plots
use site or block structure when plots are not independent
do not encode a p-value threshold as proof of presence or absence of an effect
review_notes: The source scripts use response-scale normal approximations for some GLM intervals; a production implementation should use an appropriate link-scale or simulation interval.
The source scripts add a small constant to similarity before beta regression; a production implementation must predeclare and expose its boundary-value policy.

method_cards.label: Open- and closed-canopy predictions relative to reference plots
method_cards.denominator: mean response among compatible declared reference plots
method_cards.allowed_claim: fitted response as a percentage of the sampled reference mean
method_cards.forbidden_claim: percentage ecosystem recovery or causal effect without a defensible recovery construct and design
gates: reference mean is nonzero and based on compatible plots
prediction locations fall within observed support
model and reference uncertainty are propagated

method_cards.label: Exploratory enrichment simulation for closed-canopy plots

source_instantiation.control_donor_pool: adult trees from the selected fragment

method_cards.uncertainty: retain the full simulated distributions and show benchmark and current-condition references
method_cards.allowed_claim: outcomes under the explicitly declared sampling simulation
method_cards.forbidden_claim: realised establishment, intervention effect, feasibility, cost or restoration recommendation
gates: label as a simulation rather than an intervention forecast
expose donor-pool eligibility and draw assumptions
test sensitivity to draw count, replacement and canopy threshold
include establishment, survival and operational constraints before decision use

method_cards.label: Detection-aware occupancy from repeated complete checklists

source_instantiation.species_screen: reported in at least 5 percent of checklists across at least 50 percent of occupied 25 km grids
source_instantiation.candidate_model_set: detection covariates plus combinations of climate and land-cover occupancy predictors
source_instantiation.goodness_of_fit: chi-square test with 1000 parametric bootstrap simulations

method_cards.uncertainty: show detection probability, occupancy estimate, model-averaged interval, fit result, spatial support and source/checklist coverage separately
method_cards.allowed_claim: estimated probability of occupancy under the fitted observation model and supported predictor domain
method_cards.forbidden_claim: confirmed local presence, abundance, population trend, or transfer to a target whose environmental and observation-process gates were not evaluated
gates: use complete checklists or another defensible detection-nondetection design
retain repeated visits and detection covariates rather than treating missing reports as absence
make species-screening and effort filters question-specific and visible
inspect spatial and temporal sampling bias
evaluate goodness of fit and overdispersion
use spatially separated validation and environmental-support checks before transfer
do not apply the source study's season, time or species exclusions as universal defaults

method_cards.label: Observed records, sampled grid support and detection-adjusted range surface

source_instantiation.occurrence_support: observed records and sampled grid cells remain separate layers
source_instantiation.detection_covariates: log checklist species count and season for resident species
source_instantiation.occupancy_covariate: proportion of neighbouring cells with a report
source_instantiation.high-effort_cell_cap: randomised checklists truncated at the 95th percentile of checklists per grid
source_instantiation.range_summary: cell occupancy multiplied by cell area, with propagated standard error
source_instantiation.season_classes: winter, summer, monsoon and autumn; migrant windows are source-defined

method_cards.uncertainty: show observed points, checklist-support cells, detection probability, modelled occupancy, interval or standard error, and excluded or unsupported cells as separate layers
method_cards.allowed_claim: estimated occupied range within the declared grid, season, observation process and validated support
method_cards.forbidden_claim: confirmed presence in a model-only cell, absence in an unsampled cell, abundance, or a site-scale range inferred directly from the source national grid
gates: use authorised complete checklists or another defensible detection-nondetection design
resolve names and migratory or seasonal windows before fitting
show checklist coverage and observed records before the modelled surface
predeclare grid scale and test sensitivity to it
test whether neighbour-context terms leak the response or inflate spatial confidence
use spatially separated validation and expose unsupported cells
apply sensitive-species suppression before serving point payloads
do not reuse national thresholds or seasons as site defaults

method_cards.label: Reporting-rate trend with checklist and spatial support controls

source_instantiation.response: species reported or not reported on a complete checklist
source_instantiation.model_family: binomial complementary-log-log GLM or mixed model
source_instantiation.fixed_effects: season, season by log checklist species count, and temporal bin
source_instantiation.spatial_structure: nested coarse and fine grid random intercepts when supported
source_instantiation.source_eligibility: coverage thresholds by locations, grids, checklists and temporal bins
source_instantiation.uncertainty: simulation summaries and 2.5th to 97.5th percentile intervals

method_cards.uncertainty: show fitted reporting rate and interval together with raw checklist coverage, spatial support, eligible years and sensitivity exclusions
method_cards.allowed_claim: an effort-adjusted association between time and checklist reporting rate within the supported observation process
method_cards.forbidden_claim: population abundance, causal change, a trend from raw record counts, or a site trend when temporal and spatial support gates fail
gates: use complete checklists and preserve non-detections
make the effort proxy and its limitations visible
require adequate locations, grid cells, checklists and temporal bins for the requested scale
compare spatial coverage through time and reject unstable support
inspect model fit, residual spatial structure and sensitivity specifications
report excluded years and species rather than filling or extrapolating them
do not copy the source location, grid or checklist thresholds without scale-specific calibration
